slides.title: Be the game designer
slides.text: Today you build a level for someone else to play. Real games are made this way: plan, build, test, fix and explain.
slides.alt: Level Maker task 1: the goal is walled in. Open one wall so Bolt can reach it, then press Check.

focus.cue: Each maker task says what to build
Paint squares with the floor and wall tools
Check proves the level can be solved

slides.title: Plan it first
slides.text: Sketch your level on paper first: where Bolt starts, where the goal is, and the one tricky part. Then build it from your sketch.
slides.alt: A level built from a plan: Bolt starts top left, the goal is bottom right, and a pond of water is the one tricky part.

focus.cue: The one tricky part: a pond to get around

slides.title: The maker loop
slides.text: Check proves your level can be solved and shows its par. A tester shows what Check cannot: is it fun, and where is it confusing?
slides.alt: A built level with a gem, a key, a door and the goal, and Check says it can be solved: par 17.

focus.cue: Check: solvable, and the par is 17 blocks
A gem, a key, a door and the goal: all reachable

slides.title: The designer stays quiet
slides.text: While your tester plays, do not help. Watch quietly and take notes. A tester who gets help is not really testing the level.
slides.alt: A friend tests the level: the tester builds a program and Bolt drives it, while the maker watches.

focus.cue: Bolt drives the tester's program. You only watch

slides.title: Explain your choice
slides.text: Say why you made one choice. For example: I put the key behind the water so you have to plan a path.
slides.alt: The key sits behind a strip of water, so Bolt must plan a path around it before the door opens. Check: solvable.

focus.cue: The key sits behind the water
So Bolt has to plan a path around it
Only then does the door open

words.means: what you decide before you build
the person who plays your level to find problems
what the tester tells you: one fun thing, one confusing thing
the fewest blocks that solve a level

slides.title: Bolt's piece lights up
slides.text: Bolt's piece of the Spark lights up: the first of four. His roads run, his bugs are fixed and his levels are built. The next world belongs to Dot the fox, who follows clues the way you follow code.

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Robo Route at Level Maker and do the three maker tasks to finish this step. Then, as a stretch, build your own level from your plan, let a friend or someone at home test it, and fix one thing.
slides.alt: Level Maker task 1: the goal is walled in. Open one wall so Bolt can reach it, then press Check.
